roleContext.jobDescription: Intraday liquidity and funding reports come out of the treasury reporting services every hour the markets are open, and the treasury analysts read them without reading the code behind them. The engineer joining the team owns report and feed work against what the analysts specify, writes the regression suite that guards each report, sits with the analysts before every release to show them what will move on their screens, and leaves a note on every ticket saying what the change does not touch. The reporting services lead holds release approval. Reports to the reporting services lead; works with the treasury analysts, the treasury systems team and the platform SRE group.

requirements.text: Delivers report and data-feed work against the treasury analysts' specifications under the engineering standard.
Shows the analysts what will move on their reports before every release, under the pre-release walkthrough standard.
Maintains the regression suite that guards each report under the test standard.
Gets each release approved by the reporting services lead and keeps a record of which checks were own.
Leaves a note on every ticket stating what the change does not touch and the hand-over conditions.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Engineer, Treasury Reporting Services

## Experience

- Treasury reporting engineer at a bank since 2023: forty-six report and feed tickets delivered against the analysts' specifications under the engineering standard, all in my name in the ticket system.
- Before every release I sat with the analysts and walked them through what would move on their reports, under the pre-release walkthrough standard; each ticket carries the walkthrough record and the analysts' signed acceptance.
- The regression suite for the intraday liquidity and funding reports was mine to maintain; every ticket carries the suite results from the pre-release run.
- Releases went out on the reporting services lead's approval, recorded on the ticket next to a list of the checks that were mine and the checks that were the lead's.
- Every ticket ends with a note stating what the change does not touch and what the next engineer needs to know.

## Work samples

- Work sample: three tickets with walkthrough records, signed acceptances, suite results and the lead's approval, with the ticket system references as a verification trail.
